A rime is part of a syllable, so adding 'syllable' teaches learners to confuse the part with the whole.
flags.fix: rime (the part of a syllable after the initial consonant)

flags.why: The example defines the rime of bàn instead of showing the word in use.

flags.why: The meaning 'line of poetry' belongs to literary usage rather than colloquial speech, as shown in the [dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/v%E1%BA%A7n,3,0,0.html).
In học vần, vần concerns blending sounds to read, whereas the letter sense concerns alphabetical ordering, as distinguished in the [dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/v%E1%BA%A7n,3,0,0.html).
flags.fix: letter used in alphabetical ordering; ex: Danh sách được xếp theo vần A, B, C. = The list is arranged alphabetically.

flags.why: Học vần means learning to read by sounding out and blending sounds, rather than simply learning individual letters.
